verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Calendar Sync feature is well documented: it creates 'synced copies' of source events on destination calendars, keeps them in sync automatically, and defends busy time across all your schedules so double-booking is avoided. However, a hands-on community report describes a concrete failure of this exact behavior ('I have the events created by Reclaim in my calendar, but if I invite myself from another account, nothing happens'), directly contradicting the vendor's 'automatically defend time for events across all of your schedules' claim. missing for 10: independent corroboration that sync reliably works across accounts, resolution of the reported failure case, and Exchange/O365 support clarity raised by other users.
